notes.title: Added Chinese, Russian, German & Spanish Language Support
notes.content:
Added Chinese, Russian, German & Spanish Language Support

Hi everyone,

We’re excited to announce that The Dark Legacy now fully supports four additional languages: Simplified Chinese, Russian, German, and Spanish. Thanks to your feedback and testing:


All in-game text (menus, subtitles, item names, dialogues) has been localized for Chinese (Simplified), Russian, German, and Spanish.
UI fonts, text alignment, and layouts have been adjusted to fit all four new languages.
Audio subtitles for voice-over lines are now available in Chinese, Russian, German, and Spanish.
Language can be switched anytime from the main menu’s “Language” option.


A big thank you for helping us expand The Dark Legacy’s reach. Enjoy playing in your native language, and let us know if you spot any missing translations!

notes.title: Guidance & UI Updates – Patch Notes
notes.content:
Enhanced Guidance & UI Updates – Patch Notes

Hi everyone,

This update focuses on making your playthrough smoother and spookier:


Expanded in-game guidance: more clear hints and signposts.  
Ramped up horror elements—with even more on the way.  
Brightness slider now fully functional for better visibility.  
UI refinements: cleaner menus and more intuitive controls.  


Thanks for playing—and brace yourself for the next scares!

notes.title: Small Update / Patch Notes
notes.content:
Save/Load System Improvements – Patch Notes

Hi everyone,

We've released an important update to improve the stability and consistency of the save/load system. Thanks to your feedback:


Interactable lights now correctly retain their on/off state after loading.
Fusebox logic updated so fully inserted fuses restore proper power state on load.
Fixed power-related sounds replaying erroneously.
Lights can now be toggled on/off again after loading.


Enjoy the smoother experience and let us know if you hit any snags!
